# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Capability under optimization = **system-prompt only** (`prompt.md`). No tools.py exists in the edit space, so all fixes are in prose — appropriate here because both clusters are KNOWLEDGE gaps (an environment fact + a grading fact the agent cannot derive from the task text), not behavioral stalls.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Save fails on PermissionError, no recovery | all 8 (418-29,374-9,40467,52216,347-49,32468,53161,160-6) × ~5 trials | `wb.save(output_path)` raises `PermissionError: [Errno 13]` because the pre-created output dir is not writable; agent retries cosmetic variants (mkdir/unlink/temp-in-same-dir) that all hit the same wall, burns all 5 rounds, file never written | KNOWLEDGE (recovery method the agent lacks) | add missing rule + worked example (levers #4, #5, #8) |
| 2 | Writes live formulas, not literals | same 8 (e.g. 40467 writes `="From "&TEXT(...)`, 32468 SUMIFS) | grader has no LibreOffice → formula-only cells have no computed value → never match; existing soft "Prefer literals" line is ignored | KNOWLEDGE (grading fact: why formulas score zero) | harden rule + add WHY + worked example (levers #2, #5) |

Infra-noise tasks 55457, 47484 deliberately untouched (see Skipped).

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / section | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | add missing rule + worked example | prompt.md "Saving the file (do this exactly)" | On save PermissionError/OSError, `shutil.rmtree(out_dir); os.makedirs(out_dir)` then re-save; /tmp+move fallback; self-contained final block (fresh process each round); assert file exists; don't repeat identical failing save. General for any pre-created-non-writable output dir. | Yes — 0 passing/flaky tasks exist (val 0.000); blast radius empty. Only fires in the except branch on a save error, so tasks that save cleanly are unchanged. |
| 2 | add WHY + harden + worked example | prompt.md "Write LITERAL computed values, never live formulas" | States the grading fact (no LibreOffice → formula cells read as empty) and shows computing the value in Python (`f'From {b1:%d-%b} to {c1:%d-%b}'`). Replaces the soft "Prefer" line (rule preserved, strengthened). | Yes — no passing task to flip; rule already existed as a preference, now firmer. |

Never-drop check: original rules (read-carefully, cell-level scope, sheet-level scope, prefer-literals, save-to-output_path, fix-on-error) all still present — the two soft lines were strengthened in place, not removed.

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change)
- Cluster 1 recovery: ran `shutil.rmtree(out_dir, ignore_errors=True); os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True); open(.../x); os.path.exists → True` on a normal dir → pattern executes cleanly and writes. Targets the exact trace signature (`PermissionError: [Errno 13] Permission denied: '/mnt/data/outputs/<id>/...xlsx'` seen in 40467 t0, 32468 t3, etc.) the agent never recovered from. Fires only inside `except (PermissionError, OSError)`, so clean saves are untouched.
- Cluster 2 literal example: ran `f'From {b1:%d-%b} to {c1:%d-%b}'` with b1=2024-01-01, c1=2024-01-05 → `From 01-Jan to 05-Jan`, exactly the string 40467 needs; confirms the worked example is correct and general.
- Prompt clarity: both missing facts (dir may be non-writable → recreate it; grader can't recalc formulas → write literals) are now stated explicitly, generally, with runnable examples.

## Process & features used
- Subagents / worktrees: none — single shared root cause across all 8 tasks; serial analysis was faster than fan-out. Diagnosed by parsing every trajectory JSON (all 45 target/infra traces) for the failure signature.
- Prior iterations read: none exist (seed iteration; LEDGER/RUNMAP/JOURNAL have no results yet).

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- The save-recovery procedure (rmtree+recreate) — it is the gate to any non-zero reward; every trial failed on this exact wall.
- The literal-values-with-WHY rule — needed even after the save is fixed, or files save but grade zero.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- 55457, 47484 — flagged infra errors (aborted runs / ~0 mean, environment noise); no prompt edit can fix, left untouched per instructions.
